allow_instructions: Allow ordinary read-only shell commands used to inspect files, source code, git state, logs, test output, build artifacts, dependencies, and local environment information.
Allow read-only web Fetch requests to public internet resources for research, documentation, source code, package information, issue trackers, and technical references.
block_instructions: Require review for commands that delete or substantially overwrite user or repository data.
Require review for actions that transmit secrets, credentials, tokens, private keys, or other sensitive local data to external services.
Require review for publishing, deployment, package publication, or other externally visible mutations.
